At b737b14f, corpus/link.scala:233 compares names and ordinal maps but omits fromIdentity/toIdentity. No production caller found. Add the fresh-review counterexample: two target segmentations named b with onsets0/10/20 versus5000/6000/7000 and identical ordinal maps must compare unequal. Same endpoint content with different declared/composed evidence remains equal. Repair endpoint comparisons and kill their removal with named tests. Source-derived finding; proposed witness has not yet been executed.

Independent review: docs/refactor/evidence/intake-cold-review-closeout-20260923/README.md; replacement review ticket bd-01M2WTPDBB4MQBXEJ181Q85ZG2. These are separate findings, not a reconstruction of the missing historical A3.
set.title: SegmentLink.sameMappingAs must compare endpoint content identities
